Business-literacy cert; AWS names sales/PM/analyst as the intended candidate. 1 posting in 5,340 names it. Voucher allowed to expire rather than spend 25 evenings here.
The one whose bullets match the applied role: models, data quality, lineage. Worth paying for when there is slack.
Bedrock + production AI + evals. The cert that matches the actual work, at Professional difficulty.

sequence_rule: Serve the next UNMET milestone in order — now M1 (Go) or M2 (cloud+IaC), whichever the week's postings reward. Never a menu — the engine owns the sequence, and a picker hands the learner the one thing they should not have. M0 closed 2026-10-30.

_voucher_clock.benefit: one (1) 100% exam voucher per year, Amazon
_voucher_clock.rule: Expires end of the same calendar year granted. Received in 2026 -> exam on or before 2026-12-31.

The same hours go to M2.4 (Terraform + one real AWS service), which makes a sentence true that interviews actually test.
_voucher_clock.cost_of_expiring: $100 exam fee, free to him already
_voucher_clock.cost_of_not_expiring: 25 evenings on a cert that changes nothing, inside the window where the artifact that matters should be built
